description: A Fabric mod that adds planets, moons and other space stuff as unique dimensions

mods.name: Into the Dark
mods.description: Adding planets, moons and more to a voxel game near you

releases.notes:
- Fixed the Cheese Wheel not dropping itself when mined with silk touch
- Cheese Wheel recipe now unlocks when you obtain Cheese
- Block of Moon Dust recipe now unlocks when you obtain Moon Dust
- Added Found on Moon block & item tags
- Added datagen
- Un-split client and common sources

Okay so I did say that the next release would be 0.1.0 but that was before I realised that the code was a bit of a mess and that I wasn't actually ready to add dimensions. Next release though should, but still don't hold me to this, be 0.1.0 and include the very first dimension, the Moon

mods.name: Into the Dark
mods.description: Adding planets, moons and more to a voxel game near you

releases.notes:
- Added REI compatibility
- Cheese is now edible
  - Eating Cheese will give you 3 hunger points and 1 saturation point as well as 5 seconds of Strength 1
- Fixed Cheese Wheel not dropping anything when broken
  - Will always drop 1 Cheese when broken but will also drop 1 honeycomb 50% of the time
  - Is affected by Silk Touch
- Fixed Block of Moon Dust not dropping anything when broken
  - Will always drop 4 Moon Dust when broken
  - Is affected by Silk Touch

All going well this should be the final release before I get some actual dimension stuff sorted so look out for v0.1.0 coming hopefully later this week. The first dimension to be added, if you couldn't guess already, will be the Moon
